records.document_summary: Iliaș Voievode confirms Cican and his son Illea's right to part of Iurghiceni.

records.notes: The BNaR catalogue uses Cican; the scholarly transcription uses Cicican. Preserve both forms. This is an early documentary occurrence, not proof of the absolute origin or hereditary-surname status of the name.
